# Cold Email Writer Skill for Muse

Writes personalized cold outreach emails to hiring managers and founders — specific and human, not a pitch deck. Its core principle: cold emails fail when they sound like cover letters; the goal is to sound like a smart person who genuinely noticed something specific about the company. It structures the email around a real hook (a stat, a product decision, a market insight from the job description or website), keeps the subject line simple, and avoids broadcasting credentials. Discovered via skills.sh. Honest note: this is for genuine one-to-one job-seeking outreach, not bulk spam — the quality of the email depends on the specific details you can provide about the company. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Not verified.
